story.title: Our Origin
story.content: Rumuze (Symbols) exists to decode the abstract and engineer the tangible. We recognized a fracture in the digital landscape: the disconnect between brilliant engineering and effective market communication. We bridge this gap. We view code as modern symbolism—structures that define reality. By mastering these symbols, we grant our partners control over their digital destiny.
